verdict.rationale: Pilot's docs mention keeping existing QuickBooks account and historical data when switching providers, and dedicated experts help with onboarding when switching, implying migration support without loss of history. However, no evidence details how transaction-level detail is preserved during migration, no specifics on migrating from non-QuickBooks systems, and no independent/hands-on account of a migration going smoothly. Missing for 10: concrete migration process details, evidence of transaction-level fidelity preserved, and independent corroboration of successful historical data migration.
